create_model_image_chat_world: create a ModelImageChatWorld instance to run an image-based chat session between a human worker and bot
run_initial_turn: run the initial turn to show an image to both the human agent and bot in the chat world
postprocess_acts_with_image: postprocess dialogue acts to attach image features to every human message seen by the bot
get_final_chat_data: get the final chat data dictionary including the image index for the completed image chat session
make_world_for_image_chat: make a new image chat world by fetching the next image and creating a bot worker
